hook.name: LaunchGuardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that charges a 1% fee on the base-currency side of every swap, distributing proceeds among creator, treasury, and token holders (with deferral to a locker on failure). During the launch block, buys are restricted to whitelisted early buyers via an external guard token contract, with per-buyer hold caps enforced in afterSwap.
